articles.title: Upcoming New Sony Spider-Man Universe Movies and TV Shows: 2026 Marvel Spin-Off Release Dates and Beyond
articles.summary: From Brand New Day to Beyond the Spider-Verse to the Sony's Spider-Man Universe reboot, we break down all the projects currently in development in the Spider-Man universe.
articles.body:
Spider-Man is one of the few Marvel heroes with a supporting cast and rogues gallery wide enough to support an entire cinematic universe. Or so execs at Sony thought when they launched their Spider-Man Universe of spin-off movies and TV shows. But now there are only a handful of projects left on that slate, the most notable of course being Tom Holland's live-action Spidey movies, a likely new trilogy of which kicked off with Spider-Man: Brand New Day . Meanwhile, Madame Web, Morbius, and Kraven came, went, and will never be forgotten, the Venom trilogy has run its course, Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse is getting another sequel after Across the Spider-Verse, and the Spider-Man Noir series debuted in May of 2026 with Nic Cage playing the title character ... only to be cancelled after one season.

While the latest word is that Sony may now be looking to reboot its Spider-Man shared universe , there are still some projects moving forward (and several that are in limbo).

To help make sense of the various Spider-Man-adjacent projects in development, we're breaking down every Sony Marvel movie or show that's either been officially announced or rumored to be in the works. Check out the slideshow gallery below or scroll down to get the scoop on Spidey's cinematic future.

What Are the Next Spider-Man Spin-Off Movies and TV Shows Coming Out? 2026 Release Dates

Every Upcoming Spider-Man Movie Spin-Off in Development

Here's a quick bullet list of all the movies and TV shows that are in various stages of development:

Spider-Man: Beyond the Spider-Verse (In Production) - June 18, 2027

Spider-Man: Brand New Day Sequel (In Development)

Sony's Spider-Man Universe Reboot Movie (Status Unknown)

Spider-Noir Season 2 (Not Moving Forward)

Silk: Spider Society Series (Presumed Cancelled)

Untitled Female Cast Into the Spider-Verse Spin-Off (Presumed Cancelled)

Read on for more details on each project.

Spider-Man: Beyond the Spider-Verse (June 18, 2027)

The third Spider-Verse film is called Spider-Man: Beyond the Spider-Verse (dropping the Part One and Part Two from the Into the Spider-Verse sequels' titles that had previously been announced). Obviously Across the Spider-Verse, the second film in the series, leaves a lot of questions that will need to be answered in Beyond. Beyond the Spider-Verse was expected to be released on March 29, 2024, but in July of 2023, Sony changed several of its slate's release dates, including this film. It is now expected to be released on June 18, 2027. Learn more about the Spider-Verse here .

It was unclear after Spider-Man: No Way Home's release in 2021 when the next appearance of Tom Holland's wallcrawler would come. When Sony and Marvel made a new deal in 2019 to continue to share the character, which allowed No Way Home to be made, an MCU crossover film was also said to be part of that agreement. What that crossover film might be and what its status is remains unclear, although it seems almost certain that Holland will appear in Avengers: Secret Wars at the very least (and certainly the Brand New Day post-credits scene supports the idea of some kind of spidery appearance in that film or Avengers: Doomsday).

Regardless, now that Spider-Man: Brand New Day is a huge hit , you can be sure Holland and friends will return alongside director Destin Daniel Cretton for whatever Spider-Man 5: Holland Edition winds up being called. It's generally assumed that Brand New Day is the start of a new trilogy, something producer Amy Pascal hinted at all the way back when No Way Home was coming out.

While it doesn't appear we're getting any further live-action Venom sequels starring Tom Hardy, the Lethal Protector is making the jump to the animated realm. THR reports that Final Destination: Bloodlines duo Zach Lipovsky and Adam B. Stein are set to direct a feature-length animated Venom movie . If it's even half as good as the Spider-Verse films, Venom fans will have reason to celebrate.

Things have been pretty quiet on the Sony's Spider-Man Universe front since the release of Kraven the Hunter in 2024. Now we know that Sony is basically canning this shared universe and maybe starting from scratch again eventually. Sony Pictures CEO Tom Rothman said in February, 2026, that a reboot is in the works following Kraven's abysmal box office performance. So don't expect a follow-up to the Knull tease from 2024's Venom: The Last Dance .

However, when Spider-Man: Brand New Day was released, he said the following regarding plans to expand the Spidey universe: "Right now, we don’t know. ... We never looked at it as the 'Sony-Marvel Universe.' We looked at if there were worthwhile movies to make with other characters. At the moment, there are none in active development." Sure you did, Tom.

Still, with any luck the next shared universe will actually feature Spider-Man this time .

Following the announcement of Silk: Spider Society (see below), word came that Spider-Man Noir was the second series to come about from Sony and Prime Video's partnership. And indeed, the Spider-Man Noir series -- officially titled Spider-Noir -- wound up taking shape before Spider Society. A live-action show set in a Depression-era version of the Marvel Universe, it features Nic Cage as Ben Reilly -- not Peter Parker. Also known as The Spider, he's a gumshoe detective who also has spider powers.

The show came from Into the Spider-Verse producers Phil Lord and Christopher Miller and 22 Jump Street writer Orien Uziel, who serves as co-showrunner with Steve Lightfoot (Netflix's The Punisher).

Unfortunately, it was revealed in September of 2026 that a Season 2 will not be happening . What a shame. As IGN's Jim Vejvoda said in his review of Season 1 , "Cage’s Bogie-meets-Bugs Bunny pulp hero invigorates the highly entertaining, genre-bending Spider-Noir."

A more recent addition to Spider-Man's world, Silk is a heroine who was bitten by the same radioactive spider that gave Peter Parker his powers. Resurfacing after a decade spent locked in an underground bunker, Cindy Moon has followed the example of Spider-Man and become a costumed superhero. Cindy has actually made small appearances in Spider-Man: Homecoming and Avengers: Infinity War (played by Tiffany Espensen). But we assume the role would be recast for any new Silk project.

Silk was originally announced as a movie, but eventually evolved into a series that was meant to air on MGM+ and Prime Video (the first in a new partnership between Sony, MGM and Prime Video). Into the Spider-Verse's Angela Kang was to serve as showrunner, and the series would follow Cindy's origin story as she escapes imprisonment, comes to terms with her powers and seeks out her missing family. However, in May of 2024, Variety reported that the show was dropped by Amazon/MGM+ and that Sony would be trying to shop it to other buyers. There has been no word on the show since then.

Untitled Female Cast Into the Spider-Verse Spin-Off

An Into the Spider-Verse spin-off featuring an all-female cast was said to be in the works at one point, with Spider-Gwen expected to make her return. Other characters like Spider-Girl, Spider-Woman, Madame Web, Silk and even Black Cat might've been featured. Not much has been heard of this project since it was first revealed in 2018, however, and it seems likely to have died on the vine (web?).

There has been a host of rumored or reported Spider-Man spinoff movies over the years that have never actually gotten made. Along with Venom, one of the earliest Spider-Man spinoff movies Sony pursued was Silver & Black, a team-up film featuring mercenary Silver Sable and master thief/occasional Spider-Man love interest Black Cat. While Sony went as far as hiring director Gina Prince-Bythewood (The Secret Life of Bees) and dating the film for a February 2019 release, it was eventually canceled. Last we heard, the studio was reworking Silver & Black into solo movies for the characters, though presumably those projects have stalled out at this point. In 2020, reports indicated that Black Cat and Silver Sable might become TV projects for Sony instead.

Variety reported in March 2018 that director Spike Lee was in talks to direct a Nightwatch film, though Lee has since said he is not attached. The vigilante hero wears a durable nanotechnology costume that enhances his strength by stimulating his adrenal glands, but apparently is not capable of getting him out of development hell.

Another fairly recent addition to the Spider-Man universe, Jackpot has often fought alongside Spider-Man in defense of New York City. When she was first introduced, readers were led to believe she was actually Mary Jane Watson in disguise. Instead, it was eventually revealed that Jackpot is an identity used by two different women - genetic researcher Sara Ehret and her admirer, Alana Jobson. It was reported in August 2018 that a Jackpot movie was in development, and in 2020 further news came that Marc Guggenheim was writing the screenplay. No cast or director have been revealed so far and this one also seems unlikely to happen at this point.

At CinemaCon 2022, Sony announced El Muerto, a Spider-Man spin-off movie starring musician, producer, actor, and wrestler Bad Bunny as the title character. El Muerto is a wrestler with superpowers whose mask and abilities are passed down from generation to generation. The film was reported to have a release date of January 12, 2024, at that time, and yet as of April, 2023, filming had still not begun and Bad Bunny's publicist said the film was "at a standstill," only to later clarify that it was "in development." On June 21, 2023, a Sony press release said that the film had moved to a TBD date. And in September, 2023, Bad Bunny seemed to tell Vanity Fair that he had dropped out of the film. Hmmm...

Sony Pictures Entertainment execs clearly have plans for the Marvel characters they have the rights to. “We have the next seven or eight years laid out as to what we’re going to do with that asset, and that will not only be on the film side -- it’ll be on the TV side,” said Sony Pictures Entertainment chairman Tony Vinciquerra. “Our television group will have its own set of characters from within that universe that we will seek to develop.” Of course, that was in 2019, so we're already seven years into his seven!

Could the Olivia Wilde-directed Spider-Woman movie that was reported on in 2020 still be in the works? Or the Roberto Orci-scripted Marvel project that was also rumored that year? How many of the projects already reported on fall under Vinciquerra's plans, or have been dropped by now? Madame Web probably already knows, but for the rest of us, time will tell.

For even more on this series, be sure to check out how to watch Sony's Spider-Man Universe Movies in chronological order .

Which of the Spider-Man spin-offs are you most looking forward to? Let's discuss in the comments!

Note: This story was updated with the most recent information available on September 18, 2026. It originally ran in August, 2018.

articles.title: The Blood of Dawnwalker Cost Just $40 Million to Develop
articles.summary: Developer Rebel Wolves' September success story, The Blood of Dawnwalker, reportedly cost just $40 million to make.
articles.body:
Developer Rebel Wolves' September success story, The Blood of Dawnwalker , cost just $40 million to make.

Information related to the Warsaw, Poland-based studio's behind-the-scenes activities comes from a new Bloomberg report. It included the news that Rebel Wolves managed to bring The Blood of Dawnwalker to life and find a solid audience with little more than the $40 million budget supplied by NetEase Inc.

Game designer Konrad Tomaszkiewicz, who previously served as one of the leading developers behind games like The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt and Cyberpunk 2077, worked on early versions of Rebel Wolves' first game with a small team back in 2022. Tomaszkiewicz self-funded the project for that first year as the team hammered out its prototype in hopes of finding a partner, with NetEase later stepping in with the fund the game while acquiring 26% of the studio.

The $40 million figure comfortably lands The Blood of Dawnwalker in the AA space instead of the AAA realm where games often carry heftier price tags. For comparison, IO Interactive's 007 First Light reportedly carried a budget of more than $200 million . Sony's struggling Marathon game is said to have had a similar budget , with games like The Last of Us Part 2 and Horizon Forbidden West also reportedly in that range .

A relatively modest budget means the risk for Rebel Wolves, NetEase, and publisher Bandai Namco wasn't quite as great, but it doesn't seem to have had any impact on their game's achievements. Metacritic recorded that The Blood of Dawnwalker has received "Generally Favorable" reviews from both critics and users alike. IGN, for example, awarded it a 9/10 , calling it "an impressive, bloody cocktail of interesting ideas and well-written characters, making it one of this year’s best open-world RPGs."

It's unclear just how successful The Blood of Dawnwalker has been since its launch for PC and consoles earlier this month, but a few clues have helped shed some light. Rebel Wolves told Bloomberg it is "extremely" happy with what it's seen so far, which includes reaching more than 1 million copies sold in just a few days. SteamDB has reported that player numbers for the single-player RPG are holding strong, too, with the game currently boasting a 24-hour peak of 24,495 concurrent users after hitting a peak of 78,188 shortly after launch.

The Blood of Dawnwalker - IGN First Exclusive Images

Tomaszkiewicz told Bloomberg that his original goal was to keep Rebel Wolves from growing too much, but as ambitions grew, so did the team. The studio employed around 90 staff in 2024 but has since ballooned to encompass 160 members. Now, as they charge ahead on The Blood of Dawnwalker sequels and more , Tomaszkiewicz said they "don't want to overdo it."

"We decided that the size of the team we have right now is the most fitting for our needs," Tomaszkiewicz said. "It’s still letting me know everyone. I can speak with everyone every day. I still feel like a creator and not a manager, which is the place I want to be."

The Blood of Dawnwalker launched for PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X/S September 3, 2026. As work on more projects happens behind closed doors, more updates for Rebel Wolves' debut title are on the way, too. New Game Plus, for example, was recently confirmed to be in the works .

Michael Cripe is a freelance writer with IGN. He's best known for his work at sites like The Pitch, The Escapist, and OnlySP. Be sure to give him a follow on Bluesky (@mikecripe.bsky.social) and Twitter (@MikeCripe).

articles.body:
The LG online store regularly launches its best deals on gaming monitors every Friday. These deals typically run through the weekend and expire Monday morning. For this week, LG is offering its 34" LG Ultragear 34GX90SA ultra-wide curved OLED gaming monitor for just $699.99 with free shipping after an extra $400 off coupon code " MONITOR400 ". It features a gorgeous curved MLA+ OLED panel, WQHD resolution, NVIDIA G-Sync compatibility, and a respectable 240Hz native refresh rate. LG OLED monitors come with a 2 year warranty that covers OLED burn-in.

34" LG Ultragear Curved 240Hz OLED Gaming Monitor for $699.99

34" LG Ultragear 34GX90SA-W 3440x1440 240Hz G-Sync OLED Gaming Monitor

The 34" LG Ultragear 34GX90SA-W is an ultra-wide WQHD OLED monitor with 110ppi pixel density, dramatic 800R curve, 0.03ms response time, and 240Hz refresh rate. This monitor is equipped with LG's MLA (micro lens array) OLED panel. MLA tech improves upon standard OLED by significantly improving brightness and producing a wider and smoother color gamut. That's pretty impressive because OLED monitors already boast instantaneous response time, true black level, and near-infinite contrast ratio, making them a superior option over non-OLED monitors as long as you can afford them.

The GX90 supports up to 240Hz refresh rate. At 3440x1440, you don't need the most expensive GPU to achieve that frame rate. In many cases an RTX 5070 can get to 240fps at 3440x1440, and an RTX 5070 Ti should be more than you'll ever need. The monitor is also G-Sync compatible and is equipped with both HDMI and DisplayPorts.

articles.title: Final Fantasy 7 Revelation Director Warns of 200GB Install Size for Remake Trilogy's Final Chapter
articles.summary: Final Fantasy 7 Revelation will require around 200GB of storage when it launches next year, director Naoki Hamaguchi has warned.
articles.body:
Final Fantasy 7 Revelation will require around 200GB of storage when it launches next year, director Naoki Hamaguchi has warned.

The Square Enix developer talked about the install requirements for the remake trilogy's long-awaited conclusion during an interview with VGC . When talking about how Final Fantasy 7 Revelation will compare to previous entries in the series, he confirmed that the final chapter of Cloud and Sephiroth's story will be especially demanding.

"Things are still getting worked out, but it’s probably going to be around 200GB of game," Hamaguchi said when asked about additional downloads for physical versions of Final Fantasy 7 Revelation . "I understand there are a lot of opinions about this topic, but at the end of the day, the fact is we need to overcome the hardware to a certain extent.

"One thing I want to say is, even though the game will not be on the full disc, in the position we’re in, because discs may be dying out, or maybe staying, with Final Fantasy 7 Revelation, we definitely wanted to deliver some kind of physical product. That was really important to us. Trust me!"

Managing installed games sometimes feels like packing a suitcase for a trip. Stuffing your chosen storage space with the essentials means having to choose what comes with you and what stays home, so when a big game comes along and asks to fill storage space with shiny new graphics and giant worlds to explore, hard decisions have to be made if you don't want to shell out the cash for more room. Individual install sizes often vary between platforms, but it's still something players have tried to learn to deal with as games grow increasingly complex.

It's a debacle Hamaguchi and the rest of the Square Enix team is surely aware of, but that doesn't mean anyone was willing to compromise the quality of Final Fantasy 7 Revelation. In a separate post on X/Twitter , Hamaguchi acknowledged that "a larger file size may not necessarily mean a better game," but there are other reasons to look forward to its 2027 release date.

Final Fantasy 7 Revelation Preview Screenshots

"However, this title is the culmination of more than 10 years of work from our development team and serves as the conclusion to the FFVII Remake series," he said. "We are committed to delivering a game that not only meets the expectations of our fans, but is also a work that we, as creators, can be truly proud of."

Players will learn why Final Fantasy 7 Revelation takes up so much space when it launches for PC via the Epic Games Store and Steam, Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X/S come April 8, 2027. IGN already got a taste of what's to come and shared our findings in two recent previews .

For more, you can read our interview with Hamaguchi . You can also learn more about the game yourself by checking out what Square Enix had to show at gamescom 2026 .

Michael Cripe is a freelance writer with IGN. He's best known for his work at sites like The Pitch, The Escapist, and OnlySP. Be sure to give him a follow on Bluesky (@mikecripe.bsky.social) and Twitter (@MikeCripe).

articles.title: The SteelSeries Arctis Nova Pro Omni Gaming Headset Drops to the Lowest Price Ever at Amazon Resale
articles.summary: A wireless gaming headset with infinite battery life.
articles.body:
SteelSeries' new Actis Nova Pro Omni is possibly the best wireless gaming headset you can get right now, but it's very expensive. Fortunately, there's a way to get it for a significantly lower cost. For a limited time, Amazon Resale is offering a used "like new" SteelSeries Arctis Nova Pro Omni wireless gaming headset in white for $276.36 with free shipping (it's normally $400). Amazon Resale is Amazon's official account for used goods. The products are sorted by condition, with "Like New" being the best. Amazon's 30-day return policy applies to Resale items as well.

Save 30% off the SteelSeries Arctis Nova Pro Omni Headset

SteelSeries Arctis Nova Pro Omni Wireless Gaming Headset

SteelSeries released the Arctis Nova Pro Omni earlier in May. It is the successor to the venerable Arctis Nova Pro that topped our best gaming headset chart for years. It's also SteelSeries' highest end headset outside of the Arctis Elite . It carries over all of the trademark features of the Nova Pro, including the stellar sound quality and hours-long comfort, hot-swappable battery system, active noise cancelation, and a base station with built-in GameDAC, OLED display and physical volume knob. It's also just as durable thanks to the flexible steel core headband construction.

But let's get into the improvements that make the Arcis Pro Omni a clear upgrade over its predecessor. The most notable feature is its "OmniPlay" ability. No longer do you have to buy a specific model for Xbox or PlayStation. Every Nova Pro Omni is cross compatible with the PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X, PC, Switch, and more. You can also connect to up to four separate sources simultaneously via two USB inputs, wireless Bluetooth, and line-in (its successor maxed out at two). Other improvements include an improved GameDAC with LC3+ codec that supports 96kHz/24Bit high-res audio processing and mobile app compatibility.

IGN's Michael Higham gave the Arctis Nova Pro Omni a glowing review . He wrote that "A $400 price tag is tough to swallow no matter which way you cut it. Considering what the Arctis Nova Pro Omni offers relative to the current competition, however, it makes one of the strongest cases to splurge for a high-end gaming headset if you haven't already."
